facts.text: HumanoidDeepMimic-v0 is registered with entry point humanoid_deepmimic.envs:HumanoidDeepMimicEnv
The environment class HumanoidDeepMimicEnv subclasses the legacy gym MujocoEnv and utils.EzPickle

The constructor loads asset/humanoid_deepmimic.xml through the legacy MuJoCo base with frame_skip 5, using the host-specific absolute path /home/mingfei/Documents/DeepMimic/mujoco/humanoid_deepmimic/envs/asset/humanoid_deepmimic.xml
One environment step computes forward reward from the root body's x displacement divided by dt, subtracts a 0.5*sum(a^2) control cost and a contact cost, and adds a survive reward of 1.0
The episode is not done while the state is finite and state[2] is between 0.2 and 1.0
The observation concatenates qpos[2:], qvel and cfrc_ext clipped to [-1, 1]
The reset model adds uniform(-0.1, 0.1) noise to the initial qpos and normal(0, 0.1) noise to the initial qvel
The model's simulator timestep is 0.003 s
The model declares three chest motors, chest_x, chest_y and chest_z, on the chest ball joint
The model's default motor control range is -0.3 to 0.3
The model's root free joint is commented out, so the model has no free root position in qpos
The envs package imports HumanoidDeepMimicExtraHardEnv from the module humanoid_deepmimic_extrahard_env.envs.humanoid_deepmimic_extrahard_env, which does not exist in the clone
The extrahard module defines only FooEnv, whose step, reset and render methods do nothing

determinism.notes: the fake draws its reset state from Python's random.Random(seed) and its dynamics are deterministic, so one seed repeats a fake trajectory; the upstream MuJoCo environment was not run and a fake seed does not reproduce it

gaps: the upstream environment is a legacy gym/mujoco-py environment whose constructor hard-codes one host's absolute asset path (humanoid_deepmimic_env.py:7) and whose envs package imports a module that does not exist (envs/__init__.py:2); it was not installed, imported or run
the card's second entry point, HumanoidDeepMimicExtraHardEnv, is not defined: the extrahard module contains only a stub FooEnv (humanoid_deepmimic_extrahard_env.py:5-15)

the fake is a reduced scalar stand-in, not MuJoCo: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, qpos/qvel integration or cfrc_ext; it returns a 9-number observation while the model's own observation concatenates qpos[2:] (16), qvel (17) and cfrc_ext (48) = 81 numbers (its step state_vector is 18 qpos + 17 qvel = 35)

the fake's action bound is the model's stated motor control range (-0.3 to 0.3) for the three chest motors, not the legacy gym action space: it refuses actions outside that range instead of simulating a clamp
the fake terminates only when its reduced height leaves the 0.2 to 1.0 band; it has no MuJoCo contact, joint-range or non-finite-state failure model, and the upstream step itself truncates nothing
the root free joint is commented out of the model, so the upstream state[2] used by the done check is not a torso height; the fake's height gate is a surrogate for that check
no snapshot and restore: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state pair
no rendering, viewer, reward from a motion capture clip or video output is offered by the fake
